title: Genlock voice: one open-source neural voice (Kokoro, free and offline) that sounds the same on Mac and phone, with a voice per project that is deterministic or set, so it never changes on an update
user_said: ok i liove this. lets build it. ... we could have a voice per project just like a human project manaager. ... it must be determinstic which voice it gets, or settable so tht the voices dont change with every update

text: A speaker that stays loaded (model load is ~5s per call on this Mac) and speaks a sentence at a time, for both apps
Mac app speaks replies in each project's Genlock voice instead of the system voice (VoiceController.swift)
Phone speaks in the same voice: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 for Android, the same pinned files copied from the Mac, captions a sentence at a time
